node.title: Exact weighted dictionary from E1 collision pairs to folded kernel vectors
node.statement: For every official E1 row, an oriented folded kernel vector d of profile (a,b) represents exactly M_ell(a,b) ordered class pairs, where M_ell is an explicit binomial sum over singleton allocations and common signed coordinates. Hence E_low=(1/2)sum_d M_ell(a(d),b(d)) exactly. The prize field floor removes S=16 on the binding prize-rate-1/8 row; the maximum live weight is at (4,2,S=18), and the sharpened edge budget makes |D_p(33)|<=69541 oriented low-mass vectors a simple sufficient condition. The weighted condition is weaker and preferred.
node.notes: ROUTE DICTIONARY 2026-07-28: restores exact class-pair multiplicities to folded-vector/orbit counts and converts the binding aggregate premise to a finite weighted kernel-vector budget without adding a red node; recalibrated after the prize-field-floor exclusion.
